title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: This committee ensures Indian badminton players have a direct voice in the sport's governance and development.
summary: Badminton Association of India announces the formation of its new Athletes Committee to represent player interests.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway for World Championships
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is training intensively at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for Indian junior shuttlers preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is being held at NCE, Guwahati.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting player development across the country.
summary: BAI organized an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Inter-State Team Championships 2026 Regulations Released
indian_angle: The regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships are out, setting the stage for a key domestic competition for Indian players.
summary: Badminton Association of India has released the regulations for the 2026 Inter State Team Championships.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior World Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials directly affects India's representation at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented in India's domestic junior ranking tournaments and national championships, impacting young Indian players.
summary: BAI announces the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
